summary: Evogene Ltd. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market offering of up to $2,926,500 of ordinary shares via A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners. The shares are sold at prevailing market prices with a 3.0% commission; last sale was $0.597 on June 9, 2026. The filing is a routine shelf takedown and does not describe a special situation.
